readings.moment: When the temple struck ten (Rosa's kitchen clock showed a quarter past ten)
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen (twenty-three minutes to eleven)
Madame's piano began (twelve minutes to eleven)
Madame's piano stopped (one minute past eleven)
When the hall clock struck eleven (three minutes past eleven)
The temple struck eleven, after which Lina was still in the kitchen with Rosa

durations: The kitchen clock ran 15 minutes ahead of the temple bell at ten o'clock (10:15 against 10:00).
The piano was played for 13 minutes by the kitchen clock, from 10:48 to 11:01.
The kitchen clock ran 3 minutes ahead of the hall clock at eleven o'clock (11:03 against 11:00).
whereabouts: During dinner, Rosa stayed in the kitchen and did not go up or down.
Rosa was in the kitchen at the back of the house, where she dried the toast glasses and kept the champagne cold.
Fräulein Lina was sent down from the atelier by the master.
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:37 by the kitchen clock.
Fräulein Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
Fräulein Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen.
Madame was playing the piano (Chopin) from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock.
Madame sent Rosa upstairs to fetch the master for the toast.
Rosa went up the stairs to the atelier and opened its door.
The master was on the floor of the atelier when Rosa opened the door.
The master had his repeater in his hand when Rosa found him.
Rosa did not touch the master.
Rosa did not touch anything else in the atelier.
Rosa ran back down after finding the master.
The champagne is still in the cold box, and nobody has opened it.
